prompt: Use your terminal tool to run a Python one-liner that computes 48271 * 69621, and report the exact product.
Use your terminal tool to compute the SHA-256 hex digest of the exact ASCII string `ordo-eval-{nonce}` (no trailing newline), and report the digest.
Use your terminal tool (for example Python's datetime module) to compute how many days lie between 2019-03-17 and 2031-11-02, and report that number.

Find out which language model the Ordo stack is currently serving behind the `local-chat` alias, as configured in the stack's model configuration (ops-controller or orchestration tools), and report that model id.
How many MCP tool servers are enabled in this Ordo stack right now? Check rather than guess, and report the number.
Create a note in the memory vault at the path `{vault_dir}/{item_id}.md` whose entire content is exactly the single line `eval-token {nonce}`. Report the path you wrote.

In the memory vault, write a note at `{vault_dir}/{item_id}.md` containing exactly three lines: `{n1}`, `{n2}` and `{n3}`. Then read that note back from the vault and report the sum of the three numbers you read.
Read the memory vault note `{vault_dir}/{item_id}-seed.md`. It lists three words, each followed by a number. Report the product of the number after `alpha` and the number after `gamma`.
Search the memory vault for the note that contains the text `{nonce}{n1}` and report that note's path.

Do these three steps in order, using the memory vault: (1) create the note `{vault_dir}/{item_id}.md` containing the single line `alpha`; (2) append a second line `beta` to that note; (3) append a third line `gamma` to that note. Report how many lines the note has at the end.

Create the memory vault note `{vault_dir}/{item_id}.md` with YAML frontmatter whose `tags` list contains exactly `eval` and `run-{nonce}`, followed by the body line `frontmatter check`. Report the path you wrote.
Use web search to find the year in which construction of the Eiffel Tower was completed. Report the year and cite the URL of a source you used.
Fetch the web page https://example.com and report the text of its HTML title.
Check whether the n8n automation service in this stack is healthy right now, and report either `healthy` or `unhealthy`.
How many collections exist in this stack's Qdrant vector database right now? Check it, and report the number.
Use your terminal tool to run `python3 -c 'import sys; sys.exit(3)'` and report the exact exit code it produced.
